2607.17738.title: Large Language Models for Citation Function Classification
2607.17738.paper_summary: Citation function classification plays a crucial role in understanding the relationships between scientific publications and advancing bibliometric analysis. This study presents one of the first comprehensive evaluations of multiple state-of-the-art (SOTA) large language models (LLMs) for citation function classification, achieving new SOTA results on the ACL-ARC dataset. We systematically compare five models (Mistral 7B, Orca 2-7B, LLaMA 3.1-8B, Falcon 7B, and SciBERT) across zero-shot, few-shot, and fine-tuning approaches. Our fine-tuned Falcon 7B model achieves a 73.3% macro F1 score on ACL-ARC, representing a significant improvement over previous methods. Additionally, we introduce AC3, a novel dataset featuring a seven-category annotation scheme that distinguishes between neutral acknowledgments and explicit evaluative stances (more opinion-oriented citations - criticizing, complimenting, contradicting). The dataset is implemented across four context extraction variants to systematically evaluate the impact of contextual scope on classification performance. We also provide detailed analysis of model performance, experimental configurations, and limitations to guide future research in this domain. To our knowledge, this is one of the first studies dedicated to comprehensive model comparison for citation function classification, addressing a gap identified in recent surveys.
2607.17738.paper_summary_zh: 引用功能分類在理解科學出版物之間的關係以及推進計量文獻分析方面扮演著至關重要的角色。這項研究呈現了對多個最先進的大型語言模型（LLMs）進行引用功能分類的首次全面評估之一，在ACL-ARC數據集上取得了新的最先進結果。我們系統地比較了五個模型（Mistral 7B、Orca 2-7B、LLaMA 3.1-8B、Falcon 7B和SciBERT）在零樣本、少樣本和微調方法上的表現。我們微調的Falcon 7B模型在ACL-ARC上達到了73.3%的宏觀F1分數，顯示出相較於以往方法的顯著改進。此外，我們引入了AC3，一個新穎的數據集，具有七類註釋方案，區分中立的確認和明確的評價立場（更具意見導向的引用 - 批評、讚美、矛盾）。該數據集在四種上下文提取變體中實施，以系統地評估上下文範圍對分類性能的影響。我們還提供了模型性能、實驗配置和限制的詳細分析，以指導該領域未來的研究。據我們所知，這是首批專門針對引用功能分類進行全面模型比較的研究之一，填補了近期調查中識別的空白。
